Name: Newspaper
Author: aaaa2521
Description:
[size=5][b]Newspaper / 报纸[/b][/size]
One short morning notification for the TV information you need.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tomorrow's weather in the valley, plus Ginger Island once its forecast is available on TV.[/*]
[*]Today's fortune in six simple descriptions.[/*]
[*]Whether today's Queen of Sauce recipe is unlearned or already learned. No recipe section is shown when no episode is available.[/*]
[*]One lower-left notification after waking up or loading your save. It fades automatically and does not pause the game or ask for confirmation.[/*]
[*]English and Simplified Chinese in the same download, following your game language.[/*]
[/list]Recipes are never learned automatically. Watch the television to learn an unknown recipe.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] appropriate for your game version. The tested combination is game 1.6.8 with SMAPI 4.0.8.[/*]
[*]Download Newspaper and extract its folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]You only need the compiled mod download; no SDK or build tools are needed to play.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
All reminders are enabled by default. Toggle weather, fortune, recipe status, or the whole mod. Duration defaults to 3.5 seconds before fading and can be set from 2 to 10 seconds.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and provides in-game settings. Without it, edit config.json while the game is closed. No hotkeys or extra on-screen buttons are added.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Tested on Windows with Stardew Valley 1.6.8 and SMAPI 4.0.8. Newer game/SMAPI versions, including game 1.6.15, have not yet been verified. Multiplayer, split-screen, macOS and Linux have not been tested.
The report shows the forecast at the time it appears; later changes such as a Rain Totem do not trigger another notification.

[size=4][b]简体中文[/b][/size]
报纸每天用一条左下角消息汇总明日天气、今日运势，以及当天电视食谱的学习状态。
[list]
[*]天气包含星露谷；电视可提供姜岛预报后，也显示姜岛天气。[/*]
[*]运势使用六种文字描述。[/*]
[*]当天有食谱节目时显示“有食谱待学习”或“食谱已学习”；没有节目时省略。[/*]
[*]起床或载入存档后自动提醒，无需点击确认，不暂停游戏，也不自动学习食谱。[/*]
[*]中英文共用一个安装包，跟随游戏语言切换。[/*]
[/list]将 Newspaper 文件夹解压到游戏 Mods 目录，再通过 SMAPI 启动。无需安装开发工具。
四个功能开关默认开启。通知默认停留 3.5 秒后淡出，可设置 2 至 10 秒。GMCM 为可选前置；不安装时可在退出游戏后修改 config.json。没有快捷键或额外按钮。
已在 Windows、游戏 1.6.8、SMAPI 4.0.8 环境测试通过；包含 1.6.15 在内的更新版本以及多人、分屏、macOS 和 Linux 尚未验证。

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Created by MossHarbor. Thanks to the SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu projects.
